name: Token of Inspiration
text:
Frequency once per hour

---
You grant an adjacent ally a token of your goodwill, most commonly a strand of your hair. For the next hour, that ally gains a +1 status bonus to Crafting checks, Performance checks, and Will saving throws. When the duration ends, they become immune to Token of Inspiration for 24 hours. Only one ally can benefit from Token of Inspiration at a time.
